en_text: For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.

Conceptual thoughts following habitual tendencies are like ripples on water; In each and every instant, I accumulate many causes for the miserable realms. Of this never-ending seed of cyclic existence, Please cut the root right now, O Jetsunma.
Homage to Tāre, the swift and heroic; To Tuttāre, she who dispels all fears; To Ture, the liberatress who grants all benefits; To the syllables of Svāhā, I bow to you.
Homage to Tārā, the swift and heroic, Whose eyes are like a momentary flash of lightning, She who arose from the opening stamens Of the lotus-face of the Lord of the Three Worlds.

Chokgyur Dechen Lingpa, who opened the door to profound treasures, Dorje Ziji Tsal, endowed with the seven authoritative transmissions, Pema Garwang, who clarified the Buddha’s teachings, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!

Because the great accumulation of merit has not preceded this, Though I boast of having entered the gateway of the Victor’s teachings, My trust in the Three Jewels has not been firmly established; Please uproot these karmic obscurations, O Jetsunma.
When the protector of beings was first born, All the wise ones of the world rejoiced; The hosts of Māra were filled with great anxiety, And all the non-Buddhist extremists were terrified.

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.
I prostrate with devotion to the Guru and Mañjughoṣa.

You have perfectly accomplished generosity and ethical discipline, And practiced patience and diligence; Having reached the culmination of meditative concentration and wisdom, I prostrate to you, who have perfected the perfections.

From the ocean of Avalokiteśvara’s compassion, The glory of the blooming lotus of benefit and bliss has arisen; Noble Tārā, possessing the light of nectar, Please pacify these waves of darkness filled with fear.

For us and all beings tormented by our karma, Wherever we dwell, when sickness, weapons, famine, and the like Repeatedly afflict us with countless unwanted sufferings, Please pull us from this mire of misery, O Jetsunma.
For the sake of others, With perfect intention and application, When you generated the mind for supreme enlightenment, The earth trembled in six ways.

Having attained supreme enlightenment, Your work for the sake of beings is truly wondrous; That you sacrificed your own life Before being freed from the craving of existence makes my hair stand on end.
The Victorious One subdued the hosts of Māra, Defeated all the non-Buddhist extremists, Liberated countless disciples of the Hearers, And gave prophecies to the noble heirs of the Victor.

Moreover, to the holders of the treasury of profound and vast ripening and liberation, The root and lineage gurus, the Noble Goddess, the Swift One, And the ocean of the Three Roots and Vajra Dharma protectors, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!

Beneath the sovereign Bodhi tree, you pervaded the earth and sky, subduing the hosts of Māra, Who rained down a shower of vajras, short spears, wheels, fire, mountains, and ranges of snow-peaks. When the powerful one, adorned with flower-arrows, strove to obstruct your enlightenment through miraculous displays, You defeated them well with a heart of loving-kindness; I bow my head to you, the one who attained perfect Buddhahood.
For the sake of others, With perfect intention and application, When you generated the mind for supreme enlightenment, The earth trembled in six ways.

The second Buddha, Padmākara, Lord of a hundred thousand ḍākinīs, holder of the secret mantra treasury, Bodhisattva Prince Rolpa Tsal, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!
The sages Akṣapāda, Vālmīki, Vyāsa, Ne-jok, and others, All those who had attained renown— I bow to you, who defeated them all with the Dharma.

Mother of all the Victors, medicine that dispels torment, Loving nurse, the sole kinsman of all living beings; Throughout the garland of my lives, I have no other, So I take refuge in you until I reach the heart of enlightenment.

May I recognize all beings as my mothers, with love and compassion, Not just in words, but by truly exchanging the suffering of others With my own happiness; O Jetsunma, please cultivate in me The vast and great courage of those who do this.

Even in dreams, may the supreme mind of awakening Not decline, and having completely abandoned all the works of Māra, May whatever I do with my three doors be a source That spreads benefit and happiness for the teachings and beings, O Jetsunma.
Dharmakāya Prajñāpāramitā, Bhagavatī Samantabhadrī, Complete Sambhogakāya Vajravārāhī, Emanation-display, the Venerable Mother Tārā, I pray to you: grant the supreme and ordinary accomplishments!

What need is there to speak of your qualities? Seeing the qualities of your sons, one is overcome; By the brilliance of the rising dawn, One understands the rays of the friend of the lotus.
Homage to her whose hand is beautifully adorned With a gold and blue water-born lotus, She whose sphere of activity is generosity, diligence, austerity, peace, Patience, and meditative concentration.

Svāhā! With clouds of the perfect age of enlightened activity, You let fall a rain of the jewels of virtue and excellence, Granting relief to all beings of the three realms; I prostrate to the Mother, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

With the stainless, precious vessel of your compassion, You rescue beings from the ocean of existence and peace, And grant relief in the city of the heart of enlightenment; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

In brief, to you, the Noble Lady, who is the single embodiment Of the primordial wisdom of all the Victors and their heirs, I pray with heartfelt devotion: Hold me in your care until I reach enlightenment.

Thus, the Guru of beings, of the Śākya lineage, Born from the royal line of the Ikṣvāku, By this praise of the Bhagavan, the Perfect Buddha, May beings swiftly attain omniscience.

Your heart-mind is the expanse of non-dual primordial wisdom; Though you have withdrawn the engagement and emergence of conceptual elaborations, You possess boundless splendor of awareness and love; I prostrate to the Noble Lady, the Wish-Fulfilling Wheel.

Homage to her whose face is like A hundred full autumn moons gathered together, Blazing with the brilliant light Of a thousand gathered stars.

In all my lifetimes, may I meet a spiritual friend who is not mistaken, And through them understand all the teachings; From now until enlightenment, O Jetsunma, please destroy The demonic forces that obstruct my life and liberation.

Especially for those of us terrified by the decay of these times, Which are the most degenerate of the degenerate, O Mother of the Victors, day and night, I have no thought of any refuge other than you.

Sentient beings of this degenerate age, when the five drosses are rampant, Are bound by the powerful force of afflictions and the shackles of craving. Those who have entered the teachings are driven by the red wind of jealousy; The teachings are agitated from within, and the dregs of degenerate views flourish.

Homage to you, who have the power To summon all the hosts of local guardians, Who, with a vibrating frown and the syllable HŪṀ, Completely liberate from all destitution.
